messages:
alex: Heads-up — we need to coordinate simultaneous version bumps across repos today. Targeting 0.42.0 for api-server, runtime-engine, console, sdk-js, sdk-py. Cutoff: 18:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm PR readiness?

maria: api-server PR #4823 draft ready, waiting for tj review. changelog updated under docs/CHANGELOG.md :+1:

tj: on it, will review api-server by 16:30 UTC. any migration notes for runtime cache API?

alex: runtime change is non-breaking but touches KV cache key format — runtime-engine PR #2201 includes compatibility shim. We should bump runtime to 0.42.0-rc1 first and then final tag after console/sdk merge.

ben: console PR #789 (ui for model-selector) ready, but it pulls new runtime client sdk-js@0.42.0. I'll cut a release branch console/release-0.42 in a bit.

iris: sdk-js @ npm ready after CI green; tag command I'll run: 
```
git tag -a v0.42.0 -m "sdk-js 0.42.0"
git push origin v0.42.0
npm publish --access public
```

I'll wait for api-server and runtime tags before publishing.

sam: sdk-py has a small API rename; I pushed docs and tests. PR #134 open. Want to coordinate a quick compatibility test matrix: api-server v0.42 + runtime 0.42 + sdk-js 0.42 + sdk-py 0.42. Can someone run canary? 

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job started: release-canary/0.42 — results expected in ~20m

maria: noted — I can run integration suite against canary in dev cluster (dev-inference). Will post results.

tj: quick checklist: 
- [x] changelogs updated
- [ ] PR approvals (api, runtime, console, sdks)
- [ ] version tags pushed
- [ ] release branch created for console
- [ ] docs site update plan

I'll merge api-server after +1 from maria.

alex: decision: if canary passes and all PRs approved by 18:00 UTC, we'll tag all repos and cut a coordinated release between 18:30-19:00 UTC. If any blocker, fallback: release api-server + sdks only and defer console UI.

ben: ack. I'll hold off merging console until you call it.

maria: integration passed on dev-inference: model-serving OK, kv cache looks stable. No errors in logs.

deploy-bot: canary job finished — 0 critical failures, 2 warnings (timings). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/release-canary/0.42

tj: merging api-server #4823 now.

alex: reminder — don't forget to update SDK docs with new endpoint parameter name (timeout_ms -> max_wait_ms) before publishing.

iris: published sdk-js v0.42.0 to npm and pushed tag.

sam: merged sdk-py #134 and pushed v0.42.0 tag to pypi staging.

ben: console merged to release-0.42 branch. I'll do a smoke deploy to canary region at 18:45 UTC.

alex: great work team :tada: I'll cut final tags after smoke deploy looks good. If anything goes sideways ping @alex directly.

maria: thanks all, leaving a short note in release-notes/0.42.md and pinging marketing.

iris: final tags pushed: api-server v0.42.0, runtime-engine v0.42.0, console v0.42.0, sdk-js v0.42.0, sdk-py v0.42.0

deploy-bot: release gates cleared, releasing to prod in 15m window per rollout policy.

ben: prod smoke OK, no regressions seen.

alex: RELEASE COMPLETE — thanks everyone. Closing out post-release checklist in #eng-releases.
